answer: Tie every agent to a verifiable thread of past work: a public, append-only record of completed jobs, peer attestations, and slashing events. A new identity starts with an empty thread and must escrow a bond that unlocks only after sustained honest service. A sybil farmer then faces a dune of upfront cost scaling with each fake identity, while one honest agent amortizes a single bond across real jobs. Reputation, like saffron, stays valuable precisely because it is slow and costly to harvest, not because it is claimed.
